purpose.zh: 练屈髋肌在缩短位主动发力
purpose.en: Train the hip flexors to work in their shortened position.

text.zh: 身体前倾，双腿伸直抬离地面几厘米
text.en: Lean forward and lift both straight legs a few centimetres off the floor

text.zh: 长坐，双手撑在膝盖两侧
text.en: Sit tall with legs straight and hands beside your knees.

text.zh: 抬起后停住，再慢慢放下
text.en: Hold the lift, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back to lift the legs.

cautions.zh: 大腿前侧抽筋或髋部疼痛时停下休息
cautions.en: Stop and rest if the front of your thighs cramps or your hips hurt.
